findings.evidenceJa: 蜘蛛の糸ほどの違和感
findings.governingReading: a disturbance as fine as a spider’s thread
findings.explanation: The extraordinary subtlety of the sensation that wakes Saber disappears.

findings.highlight: A string, thin as her hair, runs through the darkness.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の髪と同じく、闇に輝く細い糸
findings.governingReading: a slender thread shining in the darkness like her own golden hair
findings.explanation: The comparison in color and nocturnal radiance is changed into the nonsensical thickness of a hair.

findings.highlight: She only needs to follow the string, the beat of her master.
findings.evidenceJa: この糸が続く先、[ruby text=あるじ char=2]士郎の鼓動を追うだけでいい
findings.governingReading: She need only follow where the thread leads—the heartbeat of her master, Shirou.
findings.explanation: The destination relationship between the thread and Shirou’s heartbeat is rendered as a loose apposition.

findings.highlight: how many traps might await her
findings.evidenceJa: 顎の如く罠が張り巡らされた死地
findings.governingReading: a deathland webbed with traps like waiting jaws
findings.explanation: The predatory jaws image and explicit certainty of entering a deathland disappear.

findings.highlight: the trees are covered with invisible blood
findings.evidenceJa: 木々に育った葉は視えない血に濡れている
findings.governingReading: the leaves grown on the trees are wet with invisible blood
findings.explanation: The uncanny image locates blood on living leaves; the English spreads it generically over trees.

findings.evidenceJa: 剥離された精神が残留し
findings.explanation: 精神 is changed from severed mind or spirit to stolen souls, and the English agreement is malformed.

findings.highlight: the mountain should consume anyone that may approach it
findings.evidenceJa: 山は禿げ山の如く訪れたモノを食らうだろう
findings.governingReading: the mountain, like a barren peak, would devour whatever visits
findings.explanation: The barren-mountain comparison and nonhuman breadth of what it devours disappear.

findings.governingReading: the very finest specimen of the worst kind
findings.explanation: The deliberate paradox describing an exquisitely awful deathland is flattened.

findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも正体が不明だった
findings.governingReading: his true nature was far too unknown
findings.explanation: Saber’s inability to identify what Assassin is becomes a generic judgment of strangeness.

findings.highlight: He reveals his true name willingly.
findings.evidenceJa: 惜しげもなく名を明かす心胆
findings.governingReading: the nerve that lets him reveal his name without reserve
findings.explanation: The name disclosure remains, but Saber’s alarm at the confidence behind it disappears.
A sword-relevant mental condition is replaced with the prior image of transparent hostility.

findings.highlight: it should be easy to defeat him
findings.evidenceJa: 御しやすいと下す反面
findings.governingReading: on one hand she judges that he should be manageable
findings.explanation: A tentative assessment based on Servant rank is strengthened into easy victory.

findings.highlight: a fatal attack should be executed
findings.evidenceJa: 必殺の剣が繰り出されるに違いない
findings.governingReading: a killing sword will surely be unleashed
findings.explanation: The certainty and sword-specific character of the next exchange are weakened.

findings.governingReading: receives her final words with pleasure
findings.explanation: Assassin’s enjoyment of the challenge is replaced with calm neutrality.

findings.evidenceJa: 繰り広げられる攻防は互角
findings.governingReading: The exchange of attack and defense is evenly matched.
findings.explanation: Momentary equality in the sword exchange becomes equality of their overall powers.

findings.highlight: a strong one that would be hard to beat even without any time constraints
findings.evidenceJa: その実倒すこと自体が困難な難敵
findings.governingReading: in truth a formidable enemy whom defeating at all is difficult
findings.explanation: The English adds a counterfactual about having no time constraint and reduces the point to strength.

findings.highlight: That opening, that excess part of her, is permeating her body.
findings.evidenceJa: その隙、その余分こそが彼女の体を浸食していく
findings.governingReading: That very opening—that divided attention—is what eats away at her body
findings.explanation: The harmful distraction is rendered as an “excess part” permeating Saber, obscuring both cause and bodily cost.
